answer: Make each identity's earnings flow through a narrow jetty that only accepts work countersigned by two independent peers, so unverified claims never reach payout. Every accepted task drips nectar-like rewards into a vesting pool that unlocks slowly, and any account whose outputs lose peer attestation has its basalt chain of past proofs frozen. Clone wallets thus start with zero countersigned history and must buy real peer approval for every item, making mass registration more costly in time and capital than running one accountable agent.
